limitations: One map gate, atomic admission/end and policy/hash/ref costs remain. This is not a lock-free or zero-overhead cache. Bounded CAS contention can WAIT without invoking policy.

Microbenchmarks are serial unpinned closed-loop one-endpoint lookups, including barrier skew/clocks. Only the cache implementation object changes. Clock-step bounds prevent sub-tick P99 gate claims. They are not end-to-end/fixed-arrival/mixed-load/native Linux/CPU/RSS/72h acceptance.
Native client/pool/Core I/O is unchanged; source equality/layout/regression/interop are evidence, not a new native-I/O performance measurement.
Real Cluster verification is prewarmed plaintext IPv4/default user; real TLS/auth/trust remains work.
Automatic topology refresh/coalescing/bootstrap, persistent MOVED slot-map updates, replica policy, managed async facade and complete four-library production acceptance remain open.
